lu_lost.en: Lu Junyi fell during the rescue. Both prisoners must reach the rendezvous alive.
lu_lost.ja: 救出の途中で盧俊義が死亡した。二人とも生きて合流地点へたどり着く必要がある。
lu_lost.zh_CN: 卢俊义在营救途中阵亡；二人必须活着抵达接应地。
lu_lost.zh_TW: 盧俊義在營救途中陣亡；二人必須活著抵達接應地。

en: Shi Qian's disguise is blown! Order a retreat, shake off the pursuers, then spend 3 seconds at Cai Fu's house to recover the disguise.
Chai Jin's disguise is blown! Order a retreat, shake off the pursuers, then spend 3 seconds at Cai Fu's house to recover the disguise.

Shi Qian has restored the disguise at Cai Fu's house.
Chai Jin has restored the disguise at Cai Fu's house.
Yue He has restored the disguise at Cai Fu's house.
The western camp was destroyed. It can no longer send reinforcements. Troops already deployed remain on the field.
The city patrol camp was destroyed. It can no longer send reinforcements. Troops already deployed remain on the field.
Lu Junyi reached the rendezvous outside the city alive.
Shi Xiu reached the rendezvous outside the city alive.
